svg.title: Scientific Figure Standard workflow
svg.desc: Lock source — Inputs, units, scale — Source + config; Render figure — No upstream recompute — Vector PDF + preview PNG; Review exports — Size, type, contrast, crop — Technical Pass / Review Pending / Fail; Deliver figure + QA — Match the figure ID — Summary + QA record

text.font-family: "DejaVu Sans Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
"DejaVu Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
"DejaVu Sans", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Render and QA versioned figures without altering results.
